scientific_integrity: The matrix certificate and integer modular computations are reproducible using the embedded Python verifier. The unbounded conclusion is proved by a prime-power matrix lifting argument, not by finite computation.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard Padovan recurrence and powers of the ramified prime 23 are covered; the theorem does not imply analogous equidistribution at other primes. Historical priority is subject to the published sources located and inspected; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact 23-adic isometries and uniform distribution of Padovan numbers
